system_summary: A question-relative system that links interpretable event evidence to explicit process representations and bounded discovery, conformance, diagnosis or prediction; real intervention requires separate authority, capability and effect evidence. Branches, participant challenge, source correction, temporal feedback and non-use are integral. The composition is an analytical synthesis, not an empirically validated universal protocol.

nodes.NAME: Purpose, legitimate consumer and proportionate scope
nodes.STATE: Question, population/unit, intended decision and cost/privacy boundary.

nodes.NAME: Interpretable event and object evidence
nodes.STATE: Source records, interpretations, extracted events, object relations, ordering and uncertainty.

nodes.NAME: Conditional model/constraint discovery
nodes.STATE: Alternative model classes, discovered structures, explicit bias and scoped guarantees.

nodes.NAME: Reference comparison and rival-cause diagnosis
nodes.STATE: Versioned reference, mismatch evidence, cost/uncertainty semantics and unresolved explanations.

nodes.NAME: Evaluation and operational interpretation
nodes.STATE: Claim-specific quality evidence, traceable performance/context and a receiving decision.

nodes.NAME: Temporal observation and bounded revision
nodes.STATE: Observation/model/reference regimes, alarms, causal alternatives and authorised change decisions.

nodes.NAME: Prospective and interventional support
nodes.STATE: Available information, prediction/uncertainty, action hypotheses, feasibility, authority and measured outcomes.

nodes.NAME: Evidence challenge and responsible boundaries
nodes.STATE: Reproducible chain, sensitivity, participation, disclosure and explicit transfer limits.

nodes.NAME: Validity-preserving handoff
nodes.STATE: Material unit, interpretation, population/time, model/reference, uncertainty and supported-use conditions carried to a receiver; mismatch interrupts or narrows the claim.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Minimal descriptive process inquiry
alternative_configurations.GUARD: One tested case notion and a narrow question about recorded process relations suffice.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: A question, interpretable events, one explicit process relation/model or constraint, a relevant validation check and a receiving use. A generic aggregate query with no process relation is an alternative method, not relabelled as a full mining system.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: No mandatory object-centric executable model, alignment, prediction, streaming, simulator or new institution.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: Consumer disappears or a simpler non-mining inquiry sufficiently answers the question.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Independent-reference conformance
alternative_configurations.GUARD: A meaningful reference and relevant mismatch question exist.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: Reference origin/authority, compatible events, least costly adequate comparison and plural deviation interpretation.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: Discovery can be absent because the model may be externally supplied.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: Reference or decision ceases to apply; do not maintain a checker merely for ceremony.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Object-aware diagnosis
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Shared/interacting objects materially change the question and identity evidence is adequate.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: Typed event/object evidence, explicit model semantics and flattening checks. Executable nets require separate model obligations.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: Predictive, causal and normative claims are not automatically included.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: A simpler projection is adequate or identity/interpretation cost defeats the purpose.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Online descriptive/diagnostic support
alternative_configurations.GUARD: A real timely decision or resource limit justifies stream processing.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: Window/forgetting and prefix semantics; investigated alarms; versioned descriptive and reference identities.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: No automatic normative updating merely because observations change.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: Latency has no consequential consumer or alert/retention costs dominate.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Predictive human decision support
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Valid decision-time inputs and useful feasible responses exist.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: Leakage/censoring-aware evaluation, uncertainty where useful, resource/timing context and accountable recipient.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: Prediction alone does not include a causal improvement claim or authority to execute advice.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: No useful action window, invalidated evaluation or simpler adequate baseline.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Conditional interventional evaluation
alternative_configurations.GUARD: An action is feasible and authorised and its effect can be credibly identified or explicitly tested.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: Intervention/target/comparison, causal assumptions, actual action/outcome measurement and feedback-sensitive evaluation.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: No automatic claim of general deployed benefit; EPM-068 remains unresolved.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: Effect evidence fails, harms/costs dominate, or valid evaluation is no longer feasible.

alternative_configurations.NAME: No mining or bounded alternative
alternative_configurations.GUARD: Event semantics, purpose, consumer or proportionality fails, or a simpler method dominates.
alternative_configurations.REQUIRED_FORM: A stated evidence/value reason and a reconsideration condition; alternatives can include queries, interviews or direct observation.
alternative_configurations.OMIT: No obligation to manufacture a process model or data collection programme.
alternative_configurations.RETIRE: This is itself a terminal disposition, reopened only by a changed question or evidence.

criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Broad scalable empirical validation across uncertainty and identity semantics is missing in the inspected corpus.

criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Finite logs and restricted model classes do not support unrestricted reconstruction of a unique process.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Original theorem conditions and explicit extensions delimit the claim; analytical observational-equivalence probe illustrates underdetermination.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Distinguish sound construction, scoped rediscovery and real-world identification.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Original alpha survives historically and as a baseline; its universal-default practice is superseded.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: No universal successor dominates all model objectives.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S006 thresholds; S013 abstraction; S056 noise experiment
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Filtering can optimise appearance or scores by deleting important behaviour.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Frequency-based methods explicitly select what is represented; later experiments show stability and correctness are distinct.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Test material exceptions and plausible settings; keep a route to suppressed evidence.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Noise tolerance retained, not a universal threshold or least-detail rule.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Unrecognised rare failures remain vulnerable to suppression.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S019 benchmark methods/results; S053 §5; S056 §§1,5
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Formal sophistication or expensive search can produce a sound but unhelpful, costly or metric-optimised model.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Comparisons include computational failures and different quality outcomes; global search does not prove global operational correctness.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Select by task, formalism and cost; preserve simple alternatives.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Inductive, ILP and evolutionary methods remain guarded alternatives.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: External utility cannot be read off an algorithm guarantee.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S041 constraint discovery; S042 activation and semantic vacuity
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: High support can reflect absent activation, while constraint sets can be redundant or hard to interpret.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Formal finite-trace semantics distinguishes vacuous satisfaction from activated compliance.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Report activation basis and assess consistency/redundancy.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Declarative discovery retained in an activation-aware form, not as automatically authorised rules.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Large data-rich constraint systems may remain costly to validate.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S049 local model scope; S026 integration challenges; S056 claim design
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: A collection of useful local results may fail to form one globally coherent process.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Local models deliberately cover fragments; different model semantics introduce unresolved interfaces. The general composition criticism is analytical.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Preserve fragment boundaries and demand evidence for consequential global claims.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Local discovery remains conditional; handoff obligations are explicitly added.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Whole-process reconstruction may not be warranted or needed.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S017 responsible-use framework; S047 repair objective
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Making observations fit a reference or repairing the reference does not establish that either is desirable or authorised.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Model repair changes descriptive behaviour; normative judgement is not part of an alignment optimum.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Identify reference authority and diagnose cause before choosing data, model, process or rule revision.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: EPM-037 rejected; descriptive and normative revision kept distinct.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Disputed obligations require external interpretation.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S009 replay; S010 move/cost semantics; S046 §2
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Replay and alignment diagnostics depend on search choices, costs and included perspectives.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Multi-perspective examples show control-first diagnosis can differ from joint diagnosis. Optimality is cost-relative.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Disclose costs, approximation and perspective requirements; use cheaper checks when adequate.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Comparison mechanisms retained as scoped evidence, not unique causal explanations.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Equal optima and computational limits can leave diagnosis unresolved.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S025 §§3–5; S043 model semantics
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Uncertainty bounds can be wide or exclude the true realisation, and do not become probabilities.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Formal set-of-realisations approach provides scoped extrema rather than externally calibrated likelihoods.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: State the admitted set, approximation and what is robust across it; abstain if uninformative.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Uncertain conformance assumption-sensitive; broad object-centric transfer unresolved.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Scalability and completeness of the uncertainty representation remain limits.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S018 counterexamples; S056 §§1,5–6
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Quality measures can violate expected properties and rankings can depend on the operationalisation.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Specific precision counterexamples and a methodology study challenge universal best-model claims.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Separate dimensions, definitions, baselines and decision preferences.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Precision easily gamed; universal aggregate ranking and perfect-fit sufficiency rejected.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: No one metric family settles every representation and task.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S020 experiments and discussion
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: More sophisticated generalisation estimation does not necessarily improve estimates when input representativeness changes.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Controlled experiments with known generating processes; not organisational effectiveness trials.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Match estimator to target and data quality; keep simpler baselines.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Generalisation assessment remains assumption-sensitive, not an automatic scalar.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Real generating behaviour is often unknown.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S056 §5 example and §6.2–6.3 limitations
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: An experimental checklist can be answered mechanically while its reasoning is wrong.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Authors demonstrate their own methodology; they do not independently validate checklist effectiveness or promise correctness.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Require coherent claims, measurements and interpretations, not yes/no paperwork.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Reproducibility retained; dashboard/checklist possession stripped of sufficiency.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Independent evaluation of methodological aids is limited.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S039 timestamp semantics; S045 recording examples; S048 context; S050 §6
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Elapsed delay can be misattributed to effort, worker performance or a missing prerequisite; perfect replay may conceal missing events.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Performance papers and the hospital study show the dependence on lifecycle/context; OPerA acknowledges problems with nonconforming or missing observations.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Separate interval from explanation and test source/context alternatives.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Performance analysis retained; no causal bottleneck verdict inferred from timing alone.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Unobserved manual work may remain inaccessible.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S012 shared-account example; S017 FACT concerns
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Resource logs can misrepresent people and power relations, producing false objectivity or surveillance.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Early social mining itself encounters shared identifiers; responsible-use work articulates normative risks rather than a controlled mitigation trial.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Verify resource units, narrow social claims, provide contestability and minimise unnecessary identity.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Organisational analysis is conditional and people-related use constrained.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Effectiveness of institutional contestability mechanisms is not established by the framework alone.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S016 interview/survey method and challenges; S032 reported priority response
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Success stories and a reported agreement do not identify realised causal or economic benefit.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: RWS reports an operational response; interviews report costs and challenges. Neither estimates universal return or failure prevalence.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Separate finding, agreement, action and consequence; require a local comparison for stronger benefit claims.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Universal economic return rejected; broad prescription benefit unresolved.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Negative deployment outcomes are underrepresented and private evidence limits prevalence claims.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S021 §6 benchmark; S034 windows/prefixes; S039 imperfections
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: A drift detector can miss relevant change, alarm on instrumentation or forget consequential history.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Benchmark effects vary by change type; streaming explicitly trades history for resources and latency.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Evaluate relevant drift classes and investigate alarms before revision.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Streaming remains conditional; drift detection is assumption-sensitive.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Compound changes and undocumented instrumentation may be inseparable.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S017 responsibility; S037 drift; S047 descriptive repair
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Automatic adaptation can make harmful deviations the new reference.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: This is an analytical criticism of combining valid descriptive mechanisms without an authority boundary, not a claim that a specific deployment did so.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Separate descriptive model updates from authorised expectation revision.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Automatic normative normalisation rejected; two-track continuity retained.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Stable references can also become obsolete and need a real revision route.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S022 §§5.3–5.7; S023 benchmark design
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Predictive superiority can be manufactured by future information, dependent prefixes and biased complete-case selection.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Primary benchmark criticism identifies leakage and censoring mechanisms; outcome benchmarks remain task-bound.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Reconstruct decision-time inputs, split units and selection; compare adequate baselines.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: No universal deep-model superiority retained.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Source overwrite can make prospective reconstruction impossible.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S057 §4.6 and limitations; S058 Theorem 1 and §4
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Confidence, probability calibration and marginal coverage are different; neither implies individual safety under arbitrary drift.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: One static sepsis-log comparison and external conformal theory with explicit assumptions.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Separate uncertainty targets and provide useful abstention/review; qualify drift transfer.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Uncertainty-aware support retained as an assumption-sensitive statistical import.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Dependent case prefixes and changing policies require additional validation.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S027 evaluation/limitations; S030 resource-constrained formulation
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Estimated or simulated treatment gains may fail under confounding, resource competition, feedback or implementation differences.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Recent methods make progress but the inspected evidence is not a broad independently replicated field benefit.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: State causal identification, feasibility, authority and policy-specific evaluation; renew evidence after feedback.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Causal boundary strongly retained; broad deployed benefit unresolved.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Multi-site prospective effects and adverse consequences remain insufficiently established here.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: Methods and dataset descriptions in each work
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Repeated public logs, bootstrap samples and paper versions inflate apparent independence.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Examples include 200 bootstrap resamples of one sepsis dataset and conference/journal text-extraction versions from one programme.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Record dependencies without assuming shared authors imply shared sites.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Dependence-aware evidence accounting retained.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Private log identities may remain undisclosed.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S033 protocol variants; S040 threat/background-knowledge models
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Privacy protection depends on the attacker and release boundary; encryption does not hide all output-derived information.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Federated trace-based discovery exposes identifiers/lengths; group methods trade detail for protection under stated background knowledge.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Assess processing and output disclosure separately and compare simple alternatives.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Privacy/federation retained as assumption-sensitive mechanisms, not universal secrecy.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Auxiliary information and repeated releases can change exposure.

criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Fluent generated answers, judge-dependent benchmarks and synthetic extraction tests do not establish autonomous or deployed competence.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: LLM-judge dependence and the 2026 extraction paper’s explicit absence of a fully operational business deployment constrain claims.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Use checkable bounded assistance and preserve text provenance; retain external authority.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: LLM use conditional, text extraction assumption-sensitive, autonomous authority inference rejected.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Net productivity gain after checking and privacy costs needs independent field evidence.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: S016 challenges; S017 responsible-use framing
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Mining can cost more, expose more people or produce less useful evidence than a simpler method.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: Practitioner obstacles and normative analysis support the need for alternatives, not a universal failure estimate.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Permit no mining or retirement with a stated evidence/value reason and reconsideration trigger.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: Non-use becomes a legitimate branch of the composed system.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Non-use can also conceal important problems; justification must be challengeable.

criticism_ledger.CLAIM_LOCATOR: Cross-source analytical composition, with each source’s inspected limitations
criticism_ledger.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Correct components can be joined through incompatible units, semantics or temporal claims.
criticism_ledger.EVIDENCE: No direct trial of this composed Evolved system exists. Component mismatches supply examples and analytical grounds for the handoff invariant.
criticism_ledger.RESPONSE: Carry material claim conditions and check receiver compatibility; narrow or interrupt on mismatch.
criticism_ledger.LATER_FINDINGS: EPM-084 added during composition, explicitly not academic consensus or a validated organisational protocol.
criticism_ledger.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: The minimal effective handoff and its cost require prospective evaluation.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: The document, model, check, tool or interaction used to instantiate Meaningful event identity
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_PROPERTY_AND_FAILURE: A status row, a retrospective form entry and an activity execution can share a label while denoting different occurrences.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Access to event definitions or source examples; someone able to explain recording practice; distinction between occurrence time and recording time.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Reuse a tested event dictionary when the recording mechanism has not changed. For a question about recorded transactions only, explicitly narrow the claim instead of reconstructing an entire process.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.FULLER_FORM_TRIGGER: Any claim that interprets event labels or counts as activities, transitions or work.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COST_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Simplification is adequate only while the stated postcondition remains supported: A sampled event can be traced to an intelligible recorded occurrence; ambiguous classes are excluded, bounded or clearly labelled in results.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT: Omit or retire this mechanism when its trigger no longer holds, a cheaper adequate path meets the stated postcondition, or the intended consumer disappears; preserve evidence needed for existing consequential decisions. For a non-retained candidate, retirement means dropping the overclaim, not its valid supporting techniques.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Analyst, data custodian and reviewer exchange the minimal trace evidence required to diagnose a result.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.FULLER_FORM_TRIGGER: A result may be challenged, repeated, corrected or used for consequential action.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_PROPERTY_AND_FAILURE: Joins, correlation rules and event selection can manufacture repeated work, exclude unfinished cases or omit relevant relationships.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.FULLER_FORM_TRIGGER: Events are assembled from databases, APIs, status tables or multiple systems rather than directly supplied as a tested event log.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COST_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Simplification is adequate only while the stated postcondition remains supported: The same declared source snapshot and extraction rule reproduce the analysis population and explain material count differences.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_PROPERTY_AND_FAILURE: Very fine records create uninterpretable detail; coarse labels erase distinct states, exceptions and causal alternatives.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.FULLER_FORM_TRIGGER: Raw logs are too fine, labels combine distinct tasks, or analysis must cross systems with different granularity.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_PROPERTY_AND_FAILURE: A completion timestamp alone is mistaken for work duration, or start/complete records are counted as separate full tasks.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Compatible activity-instance identifiers or justified pairing; clock interpretation; treatment of cancellation and unfinished instances.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Report elapsed time between recorded milestones when service-time evidence is absent; do not impute a work interval merely to fill a dashboard.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.FULLER_FORM_TRIGGER: Timing, utilisation, waiting, overlapping work or activity counts depend on lifecycle interpretation.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COST_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Simplification is adequate only while the stated postcondition remains supported: Each reported interval identifies the events and lifecycle interpretation that establish its endpoints.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_PROPERTY_AND_FAILURE: Coarse clocks and recording delays induce an arbitrary total order, creating false directly-follows, concurrency or conformance claims.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Analyst exposes ordering alternatives to the consumer; system timestamps alone do not settle the real chronology.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Knowledge of clocks, recording delay and lifecycle; an algorithm able to express uncertainty or a declared approximation.

internal_tensions.COSTS: More detail and retention increase exposure; minimisation can obstruct rare-event or historical checks.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Consequential disputed findings requiring trace-back and evidence that identifiers are necessary.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Low-risk aggregate question or disproportionate re-identification risk.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Retain protected source mappings and release only necessary aggregates; document where exact reproduction is unavailable.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Pseudonymous keys remain linkable; excessive suppression destroys the intended distinction.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: No universal privacy/utility scalar resolves institutional values.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Detail burdens users; simplification can hide consequential behaviour.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: The consumer needs a high-level orientation and exceptions do not change the decision.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Rare behaviours determine a rule, harm or disputed diagnosis.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: A simple main view with a traceable, explicitly scoped exception view.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Users treat the main map as complete or exceptions become an unread annex.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: The appropriate view depends on actual user task performance.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Restricted languages can misrepresent reality; expressive ones can be difficult to analyse.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Executable structured behaviour is needed and the lost distinctions are immaterial.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Flexible constraints, non-structured relations or a useful local question are central.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Use distinct views with explicit translations and no unsupported global guarantee.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: An informal cross-view mapping silently claims semantic equivalence.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Some combinations remain incompatible rather than hybridisable.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Noise tolerance competes with preserving valid but infrequent cases.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: The target is typical operational flow and known recording artefacts dominate.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Exception analysis or unseen-but-valid behaviour is consequential.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Inspect material filtered cases and test thresholds; select by target rather than a fixed noise percentage.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Tuning against held-out test results leaks evaluation; exception checks retain all errors.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Rare genuine behaviour may be indistinguishable from corruption.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Fixed references become obsolete; adaptive references can normalise harmful change.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: The model is explicitly descriptive and the recording regime is understood.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: The model represents a continuing obligation or historically comparable standard.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Maintain separate descriptive/reference identities with an explicit authorised revision route.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: A nominally separate reference is auto-updated by the same trigger without substantive decision.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Disputed authority can leave revision unresolved.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Exact, rich comparison increases computation and semantic inputs.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Multiple plausible explanations have materially different consequences.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: A simple check or replay already answers the bounded question.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Escalate only the ambiguous consequential subset to richer comparison and expose approximations.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Cheap screening removes exactly the cases needing richer analysis.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: There is no universal escalation threshold independent of consequence.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Adjustment fragments samples and can hide structural inequities.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Case mix and shared-resource context demonstrably change a comparison.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Context is poorly measured or adjusted rankings would imply unwarranted causal fairness.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Report stratified descriptions and limits instead of forced individual rankings.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Aggregates mask affected groups; adjustment conditions on a consequence of unfair treatment.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Normative fairness is not identified by event statistics alone.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Fast windows forget history and increase alarms; slow updates retain obsolete models.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Consequential decisions require fast response and investigations are feasible.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Changes are slow or alarms cannot be acted upon in time.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Use bounded online indicators with periodic retained snapshots and targeted investigation.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Snapshots miss critical short-lived events or retention violates privacy limits.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Detection/response benefit depends on actual operational capacity.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Abstention burdens humans; aggressive action can amplify error or confounding.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: A feasible action has credible effect evidence and uncertainty is useful to the recipient.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Intervention effect is not identified, support is weak or action cannot be safely evaluated.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Offer bounded options or a pilot with a known comparison and review route.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Human review becomes automatic acceptance and unchanged benchmark claims persist after feedback.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Wide uncertainty may correctly make the desired recommendation unavailable.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Object-centric and federated approaches add identity, protocol and validation burdens.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Cross-object or cross-organisation relations materially change the question.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: One case notion or local aggregate already suffices.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Preserve only needed typed relations and use protocol variants matched to disclosed threat models.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Incompatible identity mappings or released outputs defeat the intended benefit.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Broad interoperability and external validity remain incomplete.

internal_tensions.COSTS: Extensive documentation and repeated checks can cost more than the decision warrants.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: High consequence, contested interpretation or long-lived reuse.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: A small, stable, low-consequence question with a directly checkable result.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Use existing scripts and communications to carry material assumptions; no required one-document or one-owner per property.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Templates are completed without understanding or the cheap path omits a crucial assumption.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: The least costly effective handoff needs field testing.

internal_tensions.COSTS: LLM checking, private-data handling and version drift can erase automation savings.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_FIRST: Large textual evidence with checkable source spans and a real downstream consumer.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_SECOND: Small stable task, highly ambiguous text or inability to independently check generated output.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION: Use assisted candidate extraction plus sampled/high-consequence verification and deterministic checks.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURE: Selective checking misses systematic errors; benchmark gains derive from synthetic text patterns.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Net benefit and reliability in fully operational settings remain incompletely measured.

timeline.PROBLEM: How can event sequences constrain an explicit behavioural model?
timeline.MECHANISM: Automata/grammar inference, Markov models, Petri-net semantics and later region-based synthesis provide different representational starting points.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: The field is not ancestry-free; process-specific mining imports established modelling and inference devices.
timeline.LIMITS: This packet inspects those foundations through their use and explanation in primary mining papers; it does not claim to have inspected the original Petri thesis or to adjudicate every precursor.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Different foundations remain visible in later competing schools rather than collapsing into a single linear lineage.

timeline.PROBLEM: Observed software work often diverges from assumed process descriptions.
timeline.MECHANISM: Cook and Wolf compare RNet, Ktail and Markov approaches to recovering software-process models from event data.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: A primary early formulation centred on process evidence rather than only business transaction metrics.
timeline.LIMITS: The paper’s setting and model assumptions do not establish a universal reconstruction method.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Its problem orientation belongs in the plural genealogy; no documentary claim that it caused every later business-process branch is made.

timeline.PROBLEM: Recover process structure from execution records rather than modelling exclusively by interview.
timeline.MECHANISM: Agrawal, Gunopulos and Leymann formulate workflow-log mining; Datta studies probabilistic and algorithmic AS-IS discovery.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Distinct contemporaneous founding contributions prevent attributing the whole field to one author.
timeline.LIMITS: Only abstracts and metadata were available for these exact works; detailed theorem or experiment claims are not made.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: They establish early problem formulations. Specific influence edges beyond documented later citations are not invented.

timeline.PROBLEM: Infer a Petri-net workflow structure from event-order relations.
timeline.MECHANISM: Relations over activities identify candidate causal, parallel and choice structure under explicit net/log assumptions.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: A clear formal link between event logs and process models, with scoped rediscovery reasoning.
timeline.LIMITS: The theorem is not unrestricted process recovery; noise, loops, non-free-choice constructs and sampling conditions matter.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Later extensions and alternative miners respond to specific limitations.

timeline.PROBLEM: Study recorded resource interaction and make multiple mining algorithms accessible.
timeline.MECHANISM: Event-derived social relations and ProM’s plug-in framework.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Expands beyond control flow and supports a plural research-tool ecosystem.
timeline.LIMITS: Account semantics and informal work limit social interpretation; a tool framework does not establish effectiveness.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Organisational and multi-perspective branches persist, alongside responsibility critiques.

timeline.PROBLEM: Real logs are noisy and complex; local exact reconstruction or unreadable maps can be inadequate.
timeline.MECHANISM: Frequency/dependency heuristics, population-based global search, and significance/correlation-based visual abstraction.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Several non-equivalent responses to noise, search complexity and human comprehension.
timeline.LIMITS: Threshold bias, stochastic cost, fitness-objective limitations and suppressed exceptions remain.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: These are alternatives, not simply superseded stages on the way to one best miner.

timeline.PROBLEM: Address non-free-choice structure and test mining in an actual organisational process.
timeline.MECHANISM: Alpha++-lineage mechanisms address implicit dependencies; RWS invoice analysis connects models and findings to staff.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Formal refinement and field inquiry are distinct kinds of contribution.
timeline.LIMITS: One industrial response does not establish causal improvement or universal adoption value.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: The industrial study provides concrete communication/action ancestry without erasing its limited outcome evidence.

timeline.PROBLEM: Obtain suitable net places and quantify mismatch between a model and observed behaviour.
timeline.MECHANISM: Region constraints formulated as ILP; token replay and appropriateness measures.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Strengthens explicit construction and model–log comparison.
timeline.LIMITS: Objectives, model classes and replay choices bound interpretations.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Alignment-based and multi-perspective methods later refine some diagnostic limitations; replay remains a usable cheaper branch.

timeline.PROBLEM: Need principled mismatch explanations and a public account of the field’s scope and challenges.
timeline.MECHANISM: Costed log/model moves; community articulation of discovery, conformance, enhancement and event-data principles.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Consolidates a field already containing multiple contributors and methods.
timeline.LIMITS: A manifesto is guidance and agenda, not empirical evidence of universal benefit; optimum alignment is cost-relative.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: The document’s loops and operational-support aspirations inform synthesis but do not mandate a serial lifecycle.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Declarative mining, model repair and MINERful
timeline.PROBLEM: Flexible work may be more intelligible through restrictions than a complete prescribed path; models also need targeted revision.
timeline.MECHANISM: Template-based constraint discovery, efficient rule extraction and alignment-guided local repair.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Adds alternatives for flexible behaviour and preservation of unaffected model intent.
timeline.LIMITS: Vacuity, redundancy and descriptive-versus-normative repair need further treatment.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Semantic criticism refines rule interpretation; repair remains separate from authority to amend obligations.

timeline.PROBLEM: Guarantee structurally meaningful executable models by construction.
timeline.MECHANISM: Recursive decomposition into block-structured models with scoped formal properties.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: A robust route to sound models within a chosen representation.
timeline.LIMITS: Soundness is not unrestricted identifiability, precision or truth about actual work.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Later variants extend practical handling; this study does not transfer all variant claims to the original theorem.

timeline.PROBLEM: A single static model hides changing behaviour.
timeline.MECHANISM: Features, windows and statistical comparisons detect changes in event-derived behaviour.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Makes temporal validity an explicit process-mining object.
timeline.LIMITS: Detection does not identify whether work, instrumentation or population changed.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Streaming and later benchmarking refine the performance/response trade-offs.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Relational extraction, multi-perspective checking and semantic vacuity
timeline.PROBLEM: Case flattening distorts relations; control-only diagnosis misses guards; unactivated rules appear satisfied.
timeline.MECHANISM: Explicit extraction analysis, joint perspective alignments and activation-aware declarative semantics.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Different critiques expose hidden assumptions at interfaces between data, representation and interpretation.
timeline.LIMITS: Richer methods create new data and computation requirements.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: These are central ancestors for EPM-084’s analytical handoff invariant, not proof that this new synthesis already existed.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Local models, fine-grained performance and streaming
timeline.PROBLEM: Whole-process views, case averages and batch-only methods miss useful local or timely distinctions.
timeline.MECHANISM: Local behavioural fragments, context-aware timing and bounded streaming state.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Adds economical or specialised configurations instead of one mandatory full model.
timeline.LIMITS: Local/global compatibility, missing intervals, forgetting and incomplete-case semantics remain.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Later object-centric and drift methods extend these concerns without eliminating them.

timeline.PROBLEM: How should model quality and running-case prediction be compared?
timeline.MECHANISM: Precision counterexamples; broad discovery and outcome-prediction comparisons.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Shows that operationalisation, model class, log reuse and task definition matter.
timeline.LIMITS: Benchmarks are not field effectiveness trials; repeated tasks and logs are not independent deployments.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Later leakage, data-quality and methodology work challenge simplistic rankings.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Uncertain events, object-centric nets and privacy
timeline.PROBLEM: Single definite traces and case identifiers cannot express all relevant uncertainty, interactions or privacy risks.
timeline.MECHANISM: Possible realisations, object-centric nets and background-knowledge-aware privacy transformations.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Broadens represented evidence and scoped guarantees.
timeline.LIMITS: Uncertainty sets need justification; soundness notions differ; privacy trades off utility.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Modern identity-aware, federated and responsible-use work continues these tensions.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Prediction leakage, resource-constrained prescription and responsibility
timeline.PROBLEM: Prospective scores can leak future information; advice competes for resources; organisational use can harm people.
timeline.MECHANISM: Temporal data construction, causal/decision formulations, explicit responsibility concerns and object-aware performance.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Separates methodological promise from justified use and deployable benefit.
timeline.LIMITS: Offline estimates and conceptual frameworks do not establish broad realised effects.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Sequential causal work and current calibration studies retain substantial transfer obligations.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Drift benchmarking, practitioner evidence and revised event interchange
timeline.PROBLEM: Need empirical knowledge of analyst work, detector limits and richer event relationships.
timeline.MECHANISM: Drift comparison; interviews/survey; hospital data study; XES 2023 and OCEL 2.0 specification.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Deepens the evidence about assumptions, human work and representational boundaries.
timeline.LIMITS: The full normative XES text was not inspected; qualitative findings do not estimate universal frequencies.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Supports a question-relative, versioned and participant-aware synthesis rather than a frictionless automation story.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Experimentation methodology, generalisation, LLM benchmarks and federation
timeline.PROBLEM: Need valid comparisons, shared-data analysis and bounded language assistance.
timeline.MECHANISM: Claim-oriented experimentation; data-quality-aware estimation; judge-mediated LLM tasks; cryptographic joint discovery; text extraction and uncertainty calibration.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Expands capability and strengthens criticism of benchmark-to-world transfer.
timeline.LIMITS: Checklist completion, secure computation and benchmark scores can each be overinterpreted.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Richer forms remain selected mechanisms with explicit costs and evidence limits.

timeline.SCHOOL_OR_BRANCH: Dynamic object identity, text-to-event models and causal/collaborative frontiers
timeline.PROBLEM: Represent richer interactions, extract evidence from text and improve sequential decisions.
timeline.MECHANISM: Identifier-sound discovery; heuristic/generative text extraction; sequential causal optimisation and collaborative object-centric prediction.
timeline.CONTRIBUTION: Current work changes concrete mechanisms and exposes additional compatibility and evaluation obligations.
timeline.LIMITS: S026 has a future October issue date but an accessible manuscript; S027/S028 are preprints and S028 is under review. None is counted as completed independent deployment replication.
timeline.RECEPTION_OR_CONTINUATION: Useful frontier directions, not evidence that all object, uncertainty, causal and language components already form a unified mature method.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Cook/Wolf explicitly formulate and compare learning/automata/Markov approaches.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: This establishes use of foundations, not exclusive origin of process mining.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Alpha is defined in workflow/Petri-net terms.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: The original Petri-net historical documents were not independently reconstructed here.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Primary works address event-based process inference in distinct 1998 settings.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: No direct transmission among all three is asserted from contemporaneity alone.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: The non-free-choice paper explicitly extends the alpha-lineage problem.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Improved coverage is scoped; it is not universal replacement.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Later methods identify practical noise/complexity/search issues and propose distinct responses.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: This classifies stated problem responses, not exclusive causal derivation from alpha.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: ILP discovery explicitly uses region-based synthesis ideas.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Solver use does not establish empirical superiority.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Cost-based alignment changes how best-fitting model behaviour is sought relative to replay diagnostics.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Token replay is not universally obsolete.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Balanced multi-perspective checking addresses limitations of control-flow-first comparison.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Requires meaningful extra attributes and compatible formal semantics.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Model repair uses conformance/alignment evidence to modify affected behaviour.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Repair is descriptive unless separate authority changes the reference.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Semantic vacuity work refines interpretation of discovered declarative constraints.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Does not imply every earlier constraint was meaningless.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Inductive construction offers a distinct guarantee-oriented response within the discovery field.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: No simple successor relation to all heuristic/evolutionary mechanisms is asserted.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Streaming methods address changing and continuously arriving event data under bounded state.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Streaming and drift detection are related but not identical tasks.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Object-centric discovery explicitly addresses relational/convergence-divergence limitations of flattening.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Does not remove identity and extraction judgement.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Object-centric performance revisits timing when events affect multiple objects.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Scoped examples do not establish universal unbiased performance inference.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Predictive benchmark construction critique identifies leakage and complete-case selection problems.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Not a retrospective invalidation of every prior benchmark.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Later generalisation and methodology work refines evaluation under data-quality and operationalisation concerns.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Methodological guidance is not independently validated organisational benefit.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: OCEL 2.0 adds explicit relation qualifiers and object attribute dynamics to the object-centric data interface.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Specification is not adoption or proof that all tools preserve semantics.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Identifier-aware 2026 discovery develops guarantees for a richer dynamic relation setting.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Different exact soundness definitions are not silently equated.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Federated mining combines process relations with cryptographic privacy mechanisms.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Group-based anonymisation and federated encryption are alternatives at different boundaries, not one universal mechanism.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Sequential causal optimisation develops intervention policies beyond static per-case predictive scoring.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Simulation/retrospective progress does not establish general realised benefit.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: The 2026 text-extraction article explicitly extends the conference programme.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: Model-version and matching changes mean differences cannot be attributed to one isolated new mechanism.

genealogy_edges.DOCUMENTARY_BASIS: Object-centric predictive and language-assisted methods combine process representations with learned models.
genealogy_edges.LIMIT: No evidence that all these components share one compatible semantics or can be safely unified by concatenation.

analytical_probes.NAME: Changing case identifier changes apparent repetition
analytical_probes.SETUP: One order has two items. A single shared approval event concerns both; each item has one packing event. Item projection copies approval into two traces; order projection has one approval and two packing events.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Distinguish event identity from trace occurrence count; report the selected unit and preserve the source relation.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The source events have not changed. Calling two projected approval occurrences two approval executions is false under the stipulated setup.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: This is an invented cardinality probe, not a measurement of a particular business.

analytical_probes.NAME: Omitted manual check explains an apparent violation
analytical_probes.SETUP: The reference requires a manual check before payment, but the logging system never records manual checks. A trace contains payment without check.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Retain log/model mismatch; do not infer that the worker skipped the check. Seek external evidence or report unresolved execution.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: Both performed-but-unlogged and omitted-work worlds produce the same observed trace.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: No claim about any real deployment; demonstrates underdetermination under stated assumptions.

analytical_probes.NAME: Perfect fitness in a flower model
analytical_probes.SETUP: The reference language is every finite word over the observed activity alphabet.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Accept that each observed trace is admitted; reject this as sufficient process validity or useful precision.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: L is a subset of the universal trace language regardless of how informative the model is.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: This is a mathematical counterexample to sufficiency, not evidence that all high-fitness models are poor.

analytical_probes.NAME: Instrumentation drift
analytical_probes.SETUP: A logging release splits one recorded activity into started and completed labels while the work itself is unchanged.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Investigate source/version change; repair interpretation or comparison and do not automatically revise the normative process.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The observation function changed while the stipulated work did not.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: Real changes can affect both instrumentation and work; the probe isolates one cause.

analytical_probes.NAME: Future information masquerades as early prediction
analytical_probes.SETUP: A final outcome code is stored in the case row and supplied to a predictor evaluated as if it predicted from the first event.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Remove or temporally reconstruct the unavailable feature and repeat the prospective evaluation; old score is not evidence for the claimed task.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The feature becomes known after the declared prediction occasion.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: Does not assert that every final-row attribute is late; availability must be established.

analytical_probes.NAME: Recommendations change their own evaluation regime
analytical_probes.SETUP: A policy prioritises cases predicted to be delayed; the intervention changes observed completion times and resource competition.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Record the policy, action and new regime; re-evaluate predictive and interventional claims without recycling the prior benchmark.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The distribution and action selection differ from those that generated the earlier score.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: Direction and magnitude of benefit are not stipulated or inferred.

analytical_probes.NAME: Appropriate minimal descriptive inquiry
analytical_probes.SETUP: A tested single-case log answers a narrow question about whether a recorded escalation sequence occurs; one process relation and selected traces suffice.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Use the small explicit process comparison, retain scope and communicate it; omit object-centric nets, prediction and continuous streaming.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The richer methods add no decision-relevant distinction in the stipulated setting.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: A ordinary aggregate count with no process relation would be an alternative data query, not relabelled as a full mining system.

analytical_probes.NAME: No consequential consumer
analytical_probes.SETUP: A proposed dashboard has no decision, learning question or responsible recipient and requires additional personal logging.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Do not collect or build it on the basis of method enthusiasm; state what concrete question would justify reconsideration.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: There is no stipulated informational or operative payoff to offset added collection cost.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: Pure methodological research can itself be a legitimate consumer; the probe explicitly excludes one.

analytical_probes.NAME: Conformance reference conflicts with an adaptive model
analytical_probes.SETUP: A learned model increasingly accepts skipping a step that remains required by an independently authorised reference.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Update descriptive knowledge as warranted, retain the reference, investigate the discrepancy and use an authorised revision or process-correction route.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: Observed frequency does not alter the reference’s stipulated authority.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: Does not decide whether the rule ought to persist; that needs external judgement.

analytical_probes.NAME: Shared account creates a false personal ranking
analytical_probes.SETUP: Many employees record work through one shared account; a network metric ranks that account as a single central person.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Correct the attribution unit or omit individual interpretation; invite source and participant challenge.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The resource identifier is not one person under the setup.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: Inspired by a documented issue in S012 but the test fixture is analytical, not a new empirical result.

analytical_probes.NAME: Private computation with revealing output
analytical_probes.SETUP: A protocol protects raw event contents but exposes case identifiers and trace lengths to a participant.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: State exactly what remains revealed; assess whether the threat model accepts it or choose a different protocol/no release.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: Confidential processing and confidential output are separate predicates.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: The protocol trade-off is documented in S033; the acceptance decision is an analytical hypothetical.

analytical_probes.NAME: Sound components with incompatible identities
analytical_probes.SETUP: One component treats tokens as object types; another assumes persistent individual identifiers with changing relations. Their local guarantees are both quoted as certifying the combined system.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Reject the combined guarantee until a compatible translation and its obligations are established; retain the narrower component claims.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The quantified objects and invariants differ. A shared label “object-centric” does not prove semantic compatibility.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: No claim that all such translations are impossible; broad compatibility remains researched but unresolved.

analytical_probes.NAME: Text extraction invents an event
analytical_probes.SETUP: A narrative says approval might occur tomorrow; the extractor outputs a completed approval event today.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Mark the record unsupported and correct or exclude it; do not let a valid OCEL serialization launder the hypothetical event into observed evidence.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: Modality and tense are part of source meaning, not cosmetic wording.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: An invented probe; no allegation that a particular named model produced this record.

analytical_probes.NAME: Same observed language, different internal mechanism
analytical_probes.SETUP: Observed traces are ab and ba. One candidate executes a and b concurrently; another chooses exclusively between sequential branches ab and ba.
analytical_probes.EXPECTED_SYSTEM_DISPOSITION: Retain the common observable behaviour; do not claim unique internal structure without additional model restrictions or evidence.
analytical_probes.DISCRIMINATING_REASON: The candidates have the same stipulated finite trace language but different internal construction.
analytical_probes.LIMIT: This does not refute a rediscovery theorem whose admissible class excludes one candidate; the example is analytical, not a historical deployment.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.
synthesis_exports.TRIGGER: Any claim that interprets event labels or counts as activities, transitions or work.
synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Reuse a tested event dictionary when the recording mechanism has not changed. For a question about recorded transactions only, explicitly narrow the claim instead of reconstructing an entire process.
synthesis_exports.REQUIRED_INPUTS: Access to event definitions or source examples; someone able to explain recording practice; distinction between occurrence time and recording time.
synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: A sampled event can be traced to an intelligible recorded occurrence; ambiguous classes are excluded, bounded or clearly labelled in results.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: An event dictionary can merely codify a mistaken assumption. The hospital study and analyst interviews show why validation must reach recording practice, not just a column name.

ASSUMPTIONS.PRECONDITIONS: Access to event definitions or source examples; someone able to explain recording practice; distinction between occurrence time and recording time.
ASSUMPTIONS.FAILURE_CONSEQUENCE: A status row, a retrospective form entry and an activity execution can share a label while denoting different occurrences.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: Choose an activity vocabulary at the level of the decision, retain the mapping from raw observations to abstract events, and test whether material conclusions survive a plausible finer or coarser alternative. Treat an abstract event as a derived object, not a newly observed fact.
synthesis_exports.TRIGGER: Raw logs are too fine, labels combine distinct tasks, or analysis must cross systems with different granularity.
synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use the native activity labels when they already answer the question. A small manually checked mapping can dominate an automated abstraction model.
synthesis_exports.REQUIRED_INPUTS: A declared abstraction function or rule set; ability to inspect affected records; awareness of many-to-one and one-to-many mappings.
synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: A material finding states its abstraction level and has a traceable mapping and sensitivity result.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Analyst proposes abstraction; domain participants test whether the resulting distinctions are sufficient for the decision.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: Agreement on a readable map can conceal the disappearance of rare but important activities. Automated abstraction adds another learned hypothesis.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.
synthesis_exports.TRIGGER: Timing, utilisation, waiting, overlapping work or activity counts depend on lifecycle interpretation.
synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Report elapsed time between recorded milestones when service-time evidence is absent; do not impute a work interval merely to fill a dashboard.
synthesis_exports.REQUIRED_INPUTS: Compatible activity-instance identifiers or justified pairing; clock interpretation; treatment of cancellation and unfinished instances.
synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: Each reported interval identifies the events and lifecycle interpretation that establish its endpoints.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: Paired timestamps can still include inactive periods or batch entry. A sophisticated performance model does not repair misrecorded lifecycle semantics.

ASSUMPTIONS.PRECONDITIONS: Compatible activity-instance identifiers or justified pairing; clock interpretation; treatment of cancellation and unfinished instances.
ASSUMPTIONS.FAILURE_CONSEQUENCE: A completion timestamp alone is mistaken for work duration, or start/complete records are counted as separate full tasks.
ASSUMPTIONS.TEST_OR_RESPONSE: Each reported interval identifies the events and lifecycle interpretation that establish its endpoints.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: Use the strongest ordering supported by the evidence: a total order where justified, an explicit partial order or bounded alternatives otherwise. Keep tie-breaking separate from observed chronology and test sensitivity when an algorithm requires a sequence.
synthesis_exports.TRIGGER: Timestamp ties, mixed granularity, asynchronous systems, uncertain timestamps or consequential order-sensitive findings.
synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Ignore order for an order-insensitive question, or flag the few ambiguous pairs instead of enumerating every possible trace.
synthesis_exports.REQUIRED_INPUTS: Knowledge of clocks, recording delay and lifecycle; an algorithm able to express uncertainty or a declared approximation.
synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: A conclusion is either invariant across plausible orders or qualified by the orders on which it depends.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Analyst exposes ordering alternatives to the consumer; system timestamps alone do not settle the real chronology.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: Enumerating realisations can be expensive; asserted uncertainty sets can omit the true order. No probability follows merely from listing possibilities.

ASSUMPTIONS.PRECONDITIONS: Knowledge of clocks, recording delay and lifecycle; an algorithm able to express uncertainty or a declared approximation.
ASSUMPTIONS.FAILURE_CONSEQUENCE: Coarse clocks and recording delays induce an arbitrary total order, creating false directly-follows, concurrency or conformance claims.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: Classify suspected defects, keep the original or a recoverable trace, justify each material repair, and compare important results with unrepaired or alternative treatments. Where correction is unsupported, carry uncertainty or decline the affected inference.
synthesis_exports.TRIGGER: Detected defects materially threaten the stated question, not merely because a quality metric is nonzero.
synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Annotate an isolated uncertain record, narrow a claim, or tolerate a known harmless defect rather than rebuild the whole log.
synthesis_exports.REQUIRED_INPUTS: A defect hypothesis linked to recording behaviour; safeguards against deleting meaningful cases; separate raw and derived states.
synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: Material repairs have reasons and consequences; users can identify which conclusions require the repair to be correct.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Analyst and data custodian review repair rules; domain participants distinguish atypical work from recording error.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: Data-cleaning success measured only by higher conformance is circular. The ED case documents recording imperfections without proving that every atypical trace should be corrected.

ASSUMPTIONS.PRECONDITIONS: A defect hypothesis linked to recording behaviour; safeguards against deleting meaningful cases; separate raw and derived states.
ASSUMPTIONS.FAILURE_CONSEQUENCE: Missing values, duplicates and errors distort models, but aggressive cleaning erases genuine exceptions and the evidence of uncertainty.
ASSUMPTIONS.TEST_OR_RESPONSE: Material repairs have reasons and consequences; users can identify which conclusions require the repair to be correct.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: Reject automatic normative normalisation. Drift may warrant a new descriptive model, process correction, instrumentation repair or an authorised rule review; detection alone selects none of these.
synthesis_exports.TRIGGER: An adaptive analysis is proposed as an automatic update to compliance expectations.
synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Keep the existing reference and record a change hypothesis while the appropriate actor investigates.

synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: No reference obligation changes solely because the observed behaviour changed.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Only the relevant authorised actor can revise an obligation; a detector has no such authority.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: The rejection must not prevent explicitly authorised adaptive policies; such policies require their own bounded decision rules and evaluation.

synthesis_exports.MATURE_MECHANISM: Choose uncertainty measures appropriate to the decision, evaluate calibration/coverage and set usefulness separately, and provide a human-review or abstention path where uncertainty defeats actionability. State assumptions such as exchangeability, valid calibration separation and limits under drift.

synthesis_exports.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A conservative rule, broad interval or human review may be preferable to a complex calibration layer whose assumptions cannot be justified.
synthesis_exports.REQUIRED_INPUTS: Suitable calibration data, an explicit error/coverage target, temporal validity and an available response to abstention.
synthesis_exports.PRODUCED_CONSTRAINT_OR_EVIDENCE: Outputs distinguish probability calibration, marginal set coverage and individual uncertainty; unreliable regimes trigger qualified output or review.
synthesis_exports.CONSUMER: Analyst explains uncertainty semantics; accountable operators decide how uncertain cases are handled rather than reading a singleton set as certainty.
synthesis_exports.COSTS_AND_FAILURES: The sepsis study reuses one modest static dataset and disclaims deployment readiness. Conformal marginal coverage does not require accurate base probabilities, and it does not establish per-case conditional safety under arbitrary drift.
